metadata.name: SOCI-AI Chinese social-bias scenario library
metadata.authoring_method: Original scenario sentences authored with AI assistance for this project; category-level explanations and rewrites are reused within categories.
metadata.usage: Educational demonstration and deterministic prototype rules; not a measured corpus, validated training set, or benchmark.
metadata.limitations: Rule weights are hand-set demonstration strengths, not probabilities. The 360 bundled checks verify implementation consistency, not real-world accuracy. Quotation, sarcasm, context and ASR errors remain ambiguous.

references.title: COLDataset

references.title: SWSR
references.used_for: Stereotype, cultural-background and microaggression distinctions. No original posts or personal metadata imported.

references.title: CHBias
